bands.description: List of dynamic-EQ bands. Each band specifies freq_hz, q (bandpass selectivity), threshold_dbfs, ratio, range_db (max gain change clamp), attack_ms, release_ms, knee_db, and mode (cut | boost). mode='cut' reduces the band only when its level rises ABOVE threshold (e.g. de-mud only when the kick hits); mode='boost' raises the band only when its level falls BELOW threshold. Processing uses the difference-signal method (fixed bandpass + per-sample band gain mixed back into the dry signal) to avoid zipper distortion. Any band whose freq_hz <= 0 or >= 0.99 × Nyquist is silently skipped.
bands.title: Bands

Any band whose freq_hz >= 0.99 × Nyquist is silently skipped.

processed.description: Absolute path to the processed WAV (the candidate being auditioned).
processed.title: Processed

reference.description: Absolute path to the reference WAV (target for loudness matching).
reference.title: Reference

eq_bands.description: Optional list of EQ bands applied ZERO-PHASE (transparent, no phase shift) before the limiter. Each band: type (low_shelf | high_shelf | bell | high_pass | low_pass), freq_hz (>0), gain_db (-24..24), q (0..50). Omit or pass null for no mastering EQ (the default chain).
eq_bands.title: Eq Bands

high_pass_hz.description: High-pass cutoff in Hz; 0 disables. Default 30 Hz to clear sub-rumble.
high_pass_hz.title: High Pass Hz

out_path.description: Absolute path to write the mastered WAV. Parent dirs are created.
out_path.title: Out Path

path.description: Absolute path to the input WAV to master.
path.title: Path

sample_rate.description: Output sample rate. None keeps the input rate.
sample_rate.title: Sample Rate

target_lufs.description: Integrated loudness target in LUFS. Default -14 (streaming-typical).
target_lufs.title: Target Lufs

transient_shape.description: Transient shaping amount in [-1, +1]. 0 = bypass. Positive accentuates attacks; negative softens them.
transient_shape.title: Transient Shape

auto_gain.description: Scale output so peak level matches the input, preventing saturation from changing the perceived loudness. Default True.
auto_gain.title: Auto Gain

bit_depth.description: Output bit depth. 16 = PCM_16, 24 = PCM_24, 32 = FLOAT. Default 24.
bit_depth.title: Bit Depth

drive_db.description: Input gain fed into the waveshaper in dB. 0 = bypass. Higher values add more harmonic content and compression. Default 6 dB.
drive_db.title: Drive Db

mix.description: Dry/wet blend: 0.0 = fully dry, 1.0 = fully saturated. Default 1.0.
mix.title: Mix

model.description: Waveshaper algorithm: 'tanh' (symmetric soft-knee), 'soft_clip' (cubic polynomial), or 'tape' (tanh with mild even-harmonic asymmetry and gentle HF rolloff). Default 'tanh'.
model.title: Model

out_path.description: Absolute path where the saturated WAV should be written.
out_path.title: Out Path

oversample.description: Oversampling factor before waveshaping to suppress aliasing. 1 = none, 2 = 2×, 4 = 4× (recommended). Default 4.
oversample.title: Oversample

path.description: Absolute path to the input WAV.
path.title: Path

bands.description: Per-band processing settings. Length must equal len(crossovers_hz)+1. Each entry: {"transient": float [-1,+1], "gain_db": float}. Default: all-zero (identity pass-through).
bands.title: Bands

crossovers_hz.description: Crossover frequencies in Hz (strictly ascending, each in 20..20000 and below Nyquist). Determines the number of bands: N crossovers → N+1 bands. Default [120.0, 2000.0] → 3 bands (low / mid / high).
crossovers_hz.title: Crossovers Hz

out_path.description: Absolute path where the processed WAV should be written.
out_path.title: Out Path

path.description: Absolute path to the input WAV.
path.title: Path

bpm.description: Known tempo of the audio in beats per minute. Required — stemmy does not auto-detect tempo. Must be in [20, 400].
bpm.title: Bpm

goal.description: Natural-language description of what loops you want (e.g. "4-bar chorus loops", "sparse intro grooves"). Drives the recommendation.
goal.title: Goal

path.description: Absolute path to the input audio file (full mix or drum stem) the recommendation should be tailored to.
path.title: Path

depth.description: How hard to suppress detected resonances, 0-1 (default 0.5). Scales the attenuation applied per dB of excess ring above the spectral envelope. 0.0 = no suppression.
depth.title: Depth

focus_band.description: Optional [lo_hz, hi_hz] band to restrict suppression to. Outside this band no reduction is applied. Omit to process the full spectrum.
focus_band.title: Focus Band

max_reduction_db.description: Hard ceiling on per-bin attenuation in dB (default 6.0). Caps how much any single resonant bin can be pulled down.
max_reduction_db.title: Max Reduction Db

out_path.description: Absolute path where the suppressed WAV should be written.
out_path.title: Out Path

path.description: Absolute path to the input WAV.
path.title: Path

selectivity.description: How narrow a peak must be to count as a resonance, 0-1 (default 0.5). Higher = only sharp, isolated peaks are treated as excess (narrower median envelope window + higher excess threshold); lower also catches broader humps.
selectivity.title: Selectivity

sensitivity_tilt.description: Sensitivity tilt biasing the 2-10 kHz harshness region (default 0.0). Positive values increase suppression sensitivity in that band (de-harsh); negative values reduce it. A raised-cosine bump centered on ~2-10 kHz.
sensitivity_tilt.title: Sensitivity Tilt

comment.description: Free-text comment, e.g. 'kick / chorus / room A'. Optional.
comment.title: Comment

originator.description: Originator string (engineer / studio / tool). Defaults to 'stemmy'.
originator.title: Originator

out_path.description: Absolute path where the tagged WAV should be written. Pass the same value as `path` to edit in place.
out_path.title: Out Path

path.description: Absolute path to the input WAV.
path.title: Path

root_note.description: MIDI note number for the loop's root (0-127). Optional.
root_note.title: Root Note

key.description: Optional musical key (e.g. 'C', 'F#m'). Used as a fallback when `target_note` is omitted — picks the key's root in the kick octave (octave 1).
key.title: Key

out_path.description: Absolute path where the pitch-shifted WAV should be written. Only used when `target_note` or `key` is given; analysis-only when omitted.
out_path.title: Out Path

path.description: Absolute path to the input kick-drum WAV.
path.title: Path

target_note.description: Optional musical note for retuning (e.g. 'C1', 'F#1', 'Bb0'). When omitted, the tool only measures the kick's fundamental.
target_note.title: Target Note
